message: The other day, I was in the kitchen multitasking (as usual) when I heard my smoke alarm chirp. Instead of the usual panic, I remembered I had just checked the batteries last week—small win! 🔋 I quickly turned off the stove and gave my dinner a little TLC instead of a full-on rescue mission. It got me thinking about how those little moments of preparedness can make such a difference. Have you checked your smoke alarms lately?
